text:
lina: Quick sync — we need to pick a clear priority for the routing story this quarter. Customers are asking both for route-level API controls (rate limits, fallback routing) and for a polished Console UI that surfaces routing policies. Which do we push first?

sam: my vote is API-first. reduces developer friction for integrations and unblocks product teams faster. console can follow.

anya: +1 api-first from design — but we should avoid a crappy console experience that confuses customers when they switch to the UI. can we do a minimal console surface that reads what the API sets?

evan: RICE quick attempt? Impact: high for both. Reach: API maybe 60% of customers, Console 30% (self-serve users). Confidence: API 70%, Console 50%. Effort: API 3, Console 2 (console has more polish time). That points to API-first but not by a landslide.

maria: Customer voice: several enterprise accounts explicitly asked for Console visibility before buying Dedicated. They care about being able to audit routing. So for sales motion console matters.

reza: engineering note — route-level API controls map cleanly to existing runtime rules; turnaround for a minimal API is ~3 sprints. Console work needs new wiring + policy editor — closer to 4-5 sprints for a production UX.

lina: ok so tradeoffs: API unlocks dev experience quickly; Console unlocks sales/enterprise confidence. We need launch criteria too. Suggestion: ship API with stable schema + audit logs, and a "Console Read" (view-only dashboard) so sales demos can show routing. Then iterate Console write in next release. Thoughts?

sam: that split feels pragmatic. We should define measurable launch criteria for the API:
- public spec and SDK support
- canary with 2 internal teams
- telemetry: route invocation, failover rate, latency impact <= +15%
- audit log retention 90d

anya: for the Console Read view, we can wire a read-only dashboard that surfaces active rules, last applied fallback, and a gating CTA for "Request Console Edit" (routes to PM flow). That reduces immediate design/qa burden.

maria: Sales win condition: ability to demo routing + show audit log for one enterprise. If we can demo with read-only Console, that's enough to advance deals.

evan: We should set a small RICE score doc to keep this defensible for leadership. I'll sketch numbers and drop in the roadmap doc.

reza: one more infra flag: need to ensure we can hot-reload policy without restart. That's part of the API launch criteria or we risk downtime during edits. Ops impact low if we do it now.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout window for API canary requested: 1768060000 - 1768063600 (pending approvals).

lina: next steps: Evan -> RICE doc by EOD, Reza -> infra checklist for hot-reload + telemetry, Anya -> minimal Console Read mock by mid-week, Sam/Maria -> align on customer demo script. We'll reconvene Friday. :thumbsup:
